beforeMetadata.meaning: Captured before this package registered its new change fragment

beforeNormalized.meaning: Immutable normalized observation for the whole bounded package; not an immediate precompletion capture

immediatePrecompletionMetadata.meaning: Exact selected standard manifest entry after implementation/change-fragment registration, before completion

immediatePrecompletionRaw.meaning: Exact raw ledger bytes; implementation did not change the raw ledger

comparison.meaning: Whole-package preimplementation baseline to completed observation; new change registration is an implementation observation, not added accounting scope

noDuplicateNormalizedCapture: Immediate precompletion source is reconstructible at immutable implementation revision; no separate immediate normalized snapshot is claimed.
